name: Your Channel
_note: Starter brand. Replace name, wordmark, palette and links with your own; keep palette.json in sync (qa/palette checks brand scenes against it).

wordmark._note: Drawn in code with Space Grotesk 700 (OFL). Wrap characters of `marked` in {{ }} to draw them in the accent colour.

endScreen._note: YouTube end screens: last 5-20 s, up to 4 elements, video at least 25 s. YouTube publishes no pixel sizes; these slots follow common third-party layouts. Adjust here.
